profile.headline: Software Engineer at Airtable
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer at Airtable helping democratize software creation. Previously, I worked at Dropbox on the Paper and Filesystem teams.

Cheerful helper; engaged leader; clear communicator; effective problem solver; outdoor enthusiast; board game fan; oboist and pianist; covid-era cook.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Teams: Interface Designer, AI Solutions, Extensibility, Application Lifecycle Management, App Sandbox, Organized Workflows, Agent Platform, Core Product Quality-of-Life

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product Platform Software Engineer, Filesystem; Tech Lead, Services

- Led technical execution and direction for groups of 3-10 engineers building and maintaining the high-availability backend Go services that keep track of what user content lives in Dropbox and who has access to it.
- Shipped new key-value datastore and authentication functionality in the critical path of product feature launches.
- Built, deployed, and optimized a system to delete billions of unneeded database revisions per day, meaningfully impacting storage costs and capacity projections.
- Implemented and released 10+ service RPCs in a new tree snapshot model, simplifying the filesystem interface for product teams and unlocking future data layer improvements.
- Investigated and resolved high-urgency incidents via a 24/7 on-call rotation. Introduced dashboards, tools, and process changes to improve on-call effectiveness.
- Led onboarding efforts to successfully integrate nine new members to our team in Fall 2021.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer, Dropbox Paper; Tech Lead, Collaboration and Identity

- Led technical execution and direction for groups of 3-8 engineers building Dropbox's collaborative docs product.
- Integrated Paper docs into the main Dropbox filesystem to unify sharing and organization models.
- Built a notifications sender system and in-product notification panel UI to support bundling, delays, and delivery via multiple methods. Introduced digests and share reminders, increasing product engagement.
- Shipped new product features involving comments, image annotations, tasks, insert toolbars, and shortcuts.
- Expanded permissions model flexibility and ensured quality as one of the team's core security reviewers.
- Improved the reliability of systems that sync account data and respond to team membership changes.
- Presented recurring onboarding talks. Developed dashboards and admin tools to improve on-call effectiveness.
- Mentored an intern in 2016; Managed Dropbox's intern program in 2017.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: 6.945 Large-Scale Symbolic Systems / Advanced Symbolic Programming with Gerald Jay Sussman

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Improved internationalization infrastructure efforts as part of a two-member engineering team.
- Shipped basis for future rtl language support; Built initial framework for a cross-platform i18n library.

positions.title: 6.01 Lab Assistant, Advanced Lab Assitant, Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Guided undergraduate students in weekly software and design labs for 6.01 Introduction to Electrical Engineering and Computer Science for 4 semesters.
- Received a 2013 EECS Undergraduate Teaching Award recognizing my effectiveness.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
music21: Toolkit for Computer-Aided Musicology:
 - Published and presented paper, “Interoperable Digital Musicology Research via music21 Web Applications” at the  Service-Oriented Architecture Workshop of the Digital Humanities Conference, Hamburg, Germany, Jul. 2012.
- Expanding the project’s goal of enabling computational inquiry and manipulation of symbolic music.
- Built a flexible service-oriented architecture to enable development of web applications.
- Developing a modular web-based system to check and “pre-grade” student music theory assignments.
- Attended Boston Music Hack Day 2011, built basic music21 web apps and presented to an audience of 150.
- Presented music21 web apps at the New England Music Cognition Conference at Yale University, April 2012.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: - Built an interactive dataflow graph visual debugging tool for a proprietary query language used in Ads Backend.

positions.title: Mobile Development Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to the agile development team for the Proview Legal eReader - iOS App
- Developed new annotation and table view features, prototyped and investigated feasibility of future features.
- Created an interactive corporate data visualization app with Dan Bennett, VP of Mobile Technology; presented the project to lead editors of reuters.com for possible inclusion on the site.

positions.title: Website Designer and Developer
positions.description:
- Built a sustainable PHP/MySQL website to manage service requirements of the 280-member organization. 
- Implemented a student log-in system and a user-friendly front-end admin interface. Website averaged over 100 unique logins per week and remained in active use until 2019.

company.name: Eagan High School National Honor Society

positions.title: Programmer, Developer, Designer
positions.description:
- Built a Flash brainstorming tool used while leading our Boy Scout Troop’s annual planning meeting.
- Developed a live scoring website used for the “lightning round” of 2010 MN State Math Tournament.
- Created many interactive presentations, websites, Flash games, and 3D modeling, graphics, video projects.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and Mathematics

honors.title: Tau Beta Pi, Eta Kappa Nu
honors.description: Member of MIT’s Engineering and EECS Honor Societies; HKN Webmaster 2014-15

honors.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant Award
honors.issuer: Issued by MIT Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science · May 2013

projects.title: Selected MIT Projects
projects.description:
- Built a hierarchical web-based photo organizer; Won the student choice award (UI Design + Implementation)
- Developed a real-time collaborative text editor; Recognized for “most awesome features” (Software Construction)
- Created physics simulation, collision detection, and world editor for a rolling ball world (Computer Graphics)
- Designed and built a flexible combinator-style MapReduce system in Scheme (Large-scale Symbolic Systems)

publications.title: Interoperable Digital Musicology Research via music21 Web Applications
publications.publisher: Service-oriented Architectures for the Humanities: Solutions and Impacts. Joint CLARIN-D/DARIAH Workshop at Digital Humanities Conference 2012, Hamburg, Germany · Jul 1, 2012
